points.en: ITU is the United Nations specialized agency for information and communication technologies (ICTs).
points.hi: ITU is the United Nations specialized agency for information and communication technologies (ICTs).

points.en: Established in 1865, it is one of the oldest international organizations.
points.hi: Established in 1865, it is one of the oldest international organizations.

points.en: It coordinates global radio spectrum usage and satellite orbits.
points.hi: It coordinates global radio spectrum usage and satellite orbits.

points.en: Allocates global radio spectrum and satellite orbits.
points.hi: Allocates global radio spectrum and satellite orbits.

points.en: Develops technical standards to ensure networks and technologies interconnect.
points.hi: Develops technical standards to ensure networks and technologies interconnect.

points.en: Strives to improve access to ICTs to underserved communities worldwide.
points.hi: Strives to improve access to ICTs to underserved communities worldwide.

points.en: Facilitates international cooperation on cybersecurity and digital infrastructure.
points.hi: Facilitates international cooperation on cybersecurity and digital infrastructure.

explanation.en: I for International, T for Telecommunication, U for Union.
explanation.hi: I for International, T for Telecommunication, U for Union.

question.en: Where is the headquarters of ITU located?
question.hi: Where is the headquarters of ITU located?

question.en: What is the primary role of ITU in the global economy?
question.hi: What is the primary role of ITU in the global economy?

answer.en: Managing radio spectrum and satellite orbits to enable global communication.
answer.hi: Managing radio spectrum and satellite orbits to enable global communication.

misconception.en: ITU is a private industry body.
misconception.hi: ITU is a private industry body.

correction.en: ITU is a specialized agency of the United Nations, governed by member states.
correction.hi: ITU is a specialized agency of the United Nations, governed by member states.

fiveFacts.en: Founded in 1865 as the International Telegraph Union.
fiveFacts.hi: Founded in 1865 as the International Telegraph Union.

fiveFacts.en: Became a UN specialized agency in 1947.
fiveFacts.hi: Became a UN specialized agency in 1947.

fiveFacts.en: India is a long-standing member of the ITU Council.
fiveFacts.hi: India is a long-standing member of the ITU Council.

fiveFacts.en: Focuses on bridging the digital divide.
fiveFacts.hi: Focuses on bridging the digital divide.

fiveFacts.en: Sets standards for 5G and future communication technologies.
fiveFacts.hi: Sets standards for 5G and future communication technologies.

threeTraps.en: Assuming ITU only deals with internet governance (it covers all ICTs).
threeTraps.hi: Assuming ITU only deals with internet governance (it covers all ICTs).

threeTraps.en: Confusing ITU with private telecommunication companies.
